records.translation: Halu-halong Binhi ng Bulaklak

records.source: An assortment of flower seeds. Plant them and see what grows!
records.translation: Sari-saring binhi ng bulaklak. Itanim ang mga ito at tingnan kung ano ang tutubo!
Halo-halong Binhi

records.source: There's a little bit of everything here. Plant them and see what grows!
records.translation: May kaunti sa lahat ng uri rito. Itanim ang mga ito at tingnan kung ano ang tutubo!
Halimuyak ng Halimaw

records.source: Spray this on to draw more monsters out of hiding.
records.translation: Iwisik ito sa sarili upang lumabas sa pinagtataguan ang mas maraming halimaw.

records.preserveReason: Morel is the established borrowed Filipino name for this mushroom and is used consistently in existing item text.

records.source: Sought after for its unique nutty flavor.
records.translation: Hinahanap-hanap dahil sa natatanging lasang kahawig ng mani.
Lumot

records.source: A special type of plant that grows in shady areas.
records.translation: Natatanging uri ng halamang tumutubo sa malilim na lugar.
Sabaw na Lumot

records.source: It's thick and slimy, but edible.
records.translation: Malapot at madulas ito, ngunit maaaring kainin.
Binhing Malumot

records.source: This can be planted to grow rare wild trees.
records.translation: Maaaring itanim ito upang magpatubo ng mga bihirang ligaw na puno.
Tiket sa Sine

records.source: Admits one to the movie theater. Giving this to a friend invites them to the movies with you.
records.translation: Nagpapapasok ng isang tao sa Sinehan. Kapag ibinigay ito sa kaibigan, inaanyayahan mo siyang manood ng pelikula kasama mo.
Bb. Mananagat

records.source: Uses a bioluminescent dangler to attract prey.
records.translation: Gumagamit ng biyoluminesenteng pang-akit upang akitin ang biktima.
Batong Putik

records.source: A fine-grained rock made from ancient clay or mud.
records.translation: Batong pino ang butil at nabuo mula sa sinaunang luwad o putik.
Minumyang Paniki

records.source: The delicate wings have been perfectly preserved.
records.translation: Ganap na napanatili ang maseselang pakpak nito.
Minumyang Palaka

records.source: This ancient frog may have lived in the jungle canopy.
records.translation: Maaaring nanirahan ang sinaunang palakang ito sa tuktok ng mga puno sa gubat.
Gamot sa Kalamnan

records.source: When you've pushed your body too hard, drink this to remove 'Exhaustion'.
records.translation: Kapag labis mong napagod ang katawan, inumin ito upang alisin ang 'Pagod na Pagod'.
Binhi ng Punong-Kabute

records.source: Place this on your farm to plant a mushroom tree.
records.translation: Ilagay ito sa Bukid upang magtanim ng punong-kabute.
Tahong

records.source: A common bivalve that often lives in clusters.
records.translation: Karaniwang kabibing may dalawang talukap na madalas nabubuhay nang kumpol-kumpol.
Batong Tahong
May mga tahong sa batong ito.
Mutanteng Karpa

records.source: The strange waters of the sewer turned this carp into a monstrosity.
records.translation: Ginawang halimaw ng kakaibang tubig sa imburnal ang karpang ito.
Kahong Misteryo

records.source: A blacksmith can open this for you. Who knows what might be inside?
records.translation: Maaaring buksan ito para sa iyo ng panday. Sino ang nakaaalam kung ano ang nasa loob?
Mahiwagang Bato

records.source: Break apart to obtain stone, ores, or geodes.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng bato, mga mineral, o mga Heoda.
Mahiwagang Arnibal

records.source: A very rare syrup that is said to have magic properties.
records.translation: Napakabihirang arnibal na sinasabing may mahiwagang katangian.
